This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Finhead Stonebone]] was a member of this species. These [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]s were distinguished by their wrinkled skin, as well large [[Mouth/Legends|trunks]],<ref name="GoA" /> sometimes flanked by a pair of smaller openings.<ref name="TotJ">[[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]]</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FinheadStoneboneSpeciesConcept-ArtOfROTJ.jpg|right|250px|thumb|Concept art by Nilo Rodis-Jamero that would eventually become this species.]]
This species was first designed by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]]<ref name="Art of ROTJ">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> for the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> though this concept art would go unused.<ref name="Art of ROTJ" />
